parts:
Hi everyone,

Please help us spread the word about this postdoc opportunity. 

Best wishes,
Richard


Salary: $65,000/yr plus benefits


***

Location: University of Georgia, Athens GA

Start date: September 2022 (flexible)

A two-year postdoc position is available at the University of Georgia. The postdoc will develop hierarchical spatio-temporal models of host pathogen dynamics to inform management of white-tailed deer and chronic wasting disease (CWD) in Arkansas. Available datasets include >100,000 GPS telemetry locations, CWD testing data, and mortality information on >100 white-tailed deer, plus 3 years of data from 200 cameras spanning a CWD prevalence gradient in northwest Arkansas. Applicants with experience modeling any of the following are encouraged to apply: host-pathogen dynamics, animal movement, survival, and capture-recapture data. Applicants should have experience with R and Bayesian inference. The postdoc will be jointly supervised by Drs. Richard Chandler, Mike Chamberlain, and Gino D'Angelo. The anticipated start date is between September 1 and November 1, 2022. Preference will be given to applicants interested in moving to Athens, GA, but relocation is not required. Send a single PDF with letter of interest, CV, and contact information for three references to rcha...@warnell.uga.edu by August 1, 2022.
